criteria.name: Energy performance
criteria.description: Primary energy consumption, energy savings, CO2 emissions reduction, and energy labeling of the building.

criteria.name: Water use
criteria.description: Water consumption efficiency, wastewater reduction, and water reuse systems in building renovation.

criteria.name: Climate impact
criteria.description: Greenhouse gas emissions, carbon footprint, and climate resilience of the renovated building.

criteria.name: Economic performance
criteria.description: Investment costs, operational savings, payback period, NPV, IRR, and life-cycle cost analysis.

criteria.name: Indoor Environmental Quality (IEQ)
criteria.description: Thermal comfort, indoor air quality, visual comfort, and acoustic comfort for building occupants.

criteria.name: Energy system integration
criteria.description: Demand response, peak load reduction, load shifting, grid interaction, flexibility, and smart readiness indicators.

criteria.name: Technical feasibility
criteria.description: Constructability, technical complexity, maintenance requirements, and technology readiness of renovation measures.

criteria.name: Social impact
criteria.description: Occupant satisfaction, social acceptance, equity, accessibility, and community benefits of the renovation.
